name.en: Afya Hoteli
name.sw: Afya Hoteli

who.en:
For hotels and guest houses: a guest house of about 10 rooms or a 3-star hotel of about 40 rooms. The box carries the guest-room goods that protect health and hygiene, a front-desk first-aid box for guests and staff, hand sanitiser, housekeeping disinfection, and treated nets on a replacement rotation.

Every quantity is set per occupied room-night and multiplied by an occupancy estimate of 55%. That estimate sits inside the national bed occupancy reported by the National Bureau of Statistics for 2024 (from 39.3% in April to 73.3% in July, seen in search results only). The hotel tells Afya its real occupancy, and the next box follows it.

The guidance is WHO’s: treated nets and repellent against malaria; safe water, sanitation and hygiene against cholera; alcohol hand rub where there is no sink; cool water and a clean non-adherent dressing for burns. As cited in the old code, the OSH Rules 2015 require a stocked first-aid box and welfare facilities for staff. Afya does not sell medicines: oral rehydration salts for guests come from the licensed partner pharmacy.
who.sw:
Kwa hoteli na nyumba za wageni: nyumba ya wageni ya takriban vyumba 10 au hoteli ya nyota tatu ya takriban vyumba 40. Boksi linabeba bidhaa za vyumba vya wageni zinazolinda afya na usafi, sanduku la huduma ya kwanza la mapokezi kwa wageni na wafanyakazi, kitakasa mikono, dawa za kusafisha za wahudumu wa vyumba, na vyandarua vyenye dawa vinavyobadilishwa kwa zamu.

Kila kiasi kimewekwa kwa kila usiku wa chumba chenye mgeni na kuzidishwa kwa makadirio ya vyumba kujaa 55%. Makadirio hayo yako ndani ya kiwango cha vitanda kujaa kitaifa kilichotolewa na Ofisi ya Taifa ya Takwimu kwa 2024 (kuanzia 39.3% Aprili hadi 73.3% Julai, kilichoonekana kwenye matokeo ya utafutaji tu). Hoteli inaiambia Afya kiwango chake halisi, na boksi linalofuata linafuata hicho.

Miongozo ni ya WHO: vyandarua vyenye dawa na dawa ya kufukuza mbu dhidi ya malaria; maji salama, usafi wa mazingira na usafi binafsi dhidi ya kipindupindu; kitakasa chenye alkoholi pasipo na sinki; maji ya baridi na kifuniko safi kisichonata kwa majeraha ya moto. Kama zilivyonukuliwa kwenye msimbo wa zamani, Kanuni za OSH 2015 zinataka sanduku la huduma ya kwanza lenye vifaa na huduma za ustawi kwa wafanyakazi. Afya haiuzi dawa: chumvi za kurudisha maji mwilini kwa wageni zinatoka kwa famasia mshirika yenye leseni.

clinic_line.en: First aid at the front desk is for small injuries only. A guest with a fever is sent for a malaria test; a deep wound, a large burn or diarrhoea with weakness goes to a health facility straight away. Medicines come from the licensed partner pharmacy.
clinic_line.sw: Huduma ya kwanza mapokezi ni kwa majeraha madogo tu. Mgeni mwenye homa anapelekwa kupima malaria; jeraha kubwa, jeraha kubwa la moto au kuharisha pamoja na udhaifu kunapelekwa kituo cha afya mara moja. Dawa zinatoka kwa famasia mshirika yenye leseni.

guidance.t: Tanzania NBS, Hotel Statistics releases 2024 (national bed occupancy 39.3% in April, 44.7% in January, 53.9% in June, 70.7% in December, 73.3% in July). SEARCH SNIPPETS ONLY: nbs.go.tz refused by this session’s network
WHO fact sheet, Malaria (nets, repellents with DEET, IR3535 or icaridin, coils and vaporizers; ITNs and IRS as the two core vector controls)
WHO fact sheet, Cholera (safe water, sanitation and hygiene essential; most cases treated with oral rehydration solution)
WHO fact sheet, Drinking-water (about 505,000 diarrhoeal deaths a year from contaminated drinking water; household water treatment scheme)
WHO 2009, Guidelines on hand hygiene in health care (alcohol hand rub)
WHO fact sheet, Burns (first aid: cool running water about 20 minutes; clean non-adherent dressing)

Tanzania, Occupational Safety and Health (First Aid and Welfare Facilities) Rules 2015, GN 147. NOT OPENED (tanzlii.org refused by this session’s network); contents known from the old code’s citation and a search-result snippet only

name.en: Treated mosquito net replacement
name.sw: Kubadilisha chandarua chenye dawa

why.en: Every bed keeps a treated net (WHO core vector control). A net lasts about three years in daily use; nets are replaced on a rotation so none is torn.
why.sw: Kila kitanda kina chandarua chenye dawa (kinga kuu ya WHO). Chandarua hudumu takriban miaka mitatu kwa matumizi ya kila siku; hubadilishwa kwa zamu ili kisiwepo kilichochanika.

qty.en: About 0.3 nets a month (10 nets replaced over 36 months)
qty.sw: Takriban vyandarua 0.3 kwa mwezi (vyandarua 10 hubadilishwa ndani ya miezi 36)

items.qty_formula: 10 rooms × 1 net ÷ 36 months (about a 3-year life; planning estimate)

brands.note: Estimate. Basis: the planning figure used in the approved Mama Mjamzito box, close to the median retail price of an untreated net in a 2024 Tanzanian survey (TSh 9,000–10,000, mdpi.com, not re-opened). name.en: Treated mosquito net replacement

why.en: Every bed keeps a treated net (WHO core vector control). A net lasts about three years in daily use; nets are replaced on a rotation so none is torn.
why.sw: Kila kitanda kina chandarua chenye dawa (kinga kuu ya WHO). Chandarua hudumu takriban miaka mitatu kwa matumizi ya kila siku; hubadilishwa kwa zamu ili kisiwepo kilichochanika.

qty.en: About 1.1 nets a month (40 nets replaced over 36 months)

tiers.en: Regular = the core box with default brands. Premium = core + the premium item. Luxury = core + the luxury item. The luxury item is priced as its own line at shelf price, outside the saving (D4).
tiers.sw: Kawaida = boksi la msingi lenye chapa za msingi. Premium = boksi la msingi + bidhaa ya premium. Anasa = boksi la msingi + bidhaa ya anasa. Bidhaa ya anasa ina bei yake peke yake kwa bei ya rafu, nje ya punguzo (D4).

starter_rule.en: Starter items come once, in the first box, charged once at shelf price (no saving), with no extra delivery.
starter_rule.sw: Bidhaa za kuanzia zinakuja mara moja, kwenye boksi la kwanza, zinalipiwa mara moja kwa bei ya rafu (bila punguzo), bila usafirishaji wa ziada.

pricing_rule.formula: D4 (10 Nov 2026): core price = shelf value of the monthly box goods × (1 − 3% / 6% / 9% for 1 / 6 / 12-month plans), nearest 500, never above shelf; packing (S 3,500 · M 5,000 · L 6,500 per box) and one delivery 3,500 included. Check: price − goods at landed cost (R3 shares 78% brand / 72% pharm / 50% own) − packing − delivery − 1% points ≥ 0. Service fee = r500(partner price × 1.25), partner price = r500(walk-in × 0.70), charged in the month delivered.

open.en: Hotels buy many of these goods in bulk from wholesalers below supermarket shelf price. A trade price list is needed before selling to 3-star hotels.
open.sw: Hoteli hununua bidhaa nyingi kati ya hizi kwa jumla chini ya bei ya rafu za supamaketi. Inahitajika orodha ya bei za jumla kabla ya kuuza kwa hoteli za nyota tatu.
